_about: Business-level outreach policy shared by EVERY playbook. These are starting values you chose to run with, not legal advice. Check the rules that apply to the regions you contact.
_cooldown: No new message of any kind to a business within this many days of the last message on any channel or topic.
_recontact: A business that never answered a pitch is not pitched again automatically. null = never; a number = allowed again after that many days (still subject to every other rule).
_daily_email_cap: Counts acq AND the GEO send ledger together, because both use the same Gmail account.
_engaged: When a business has replied, no new automated pitch on another topic. Bring the extra opportunity into that conversation yourself.
